scope: Fresh unchanged full main simulation, followed by full-RHS local comparisons at the actual post-first-write state. These comparisons are not alternate integrated trajectories.
probes: Baseline: actual full state immediately after the first scheduled write
Response comparison: same full state with response[1,0,cooperation] increased by 0.1; same equations and parameters
Memory comparison: same full state with all fabric cells set to the existing empty-code rest state; all other coordinates unchanged; same equations and parameters
checks: All three full RHS evaluations succeed with finite results
The response comparison preserves decoded records
Other partner expression rate and current log-radius rate remain unchanged in response comparison
The real first record supplies positive evidence for its stored pair; no direct record is reassigned to the second pair
The first-pair cooperation rate is higher with the positive imprint than with empty material code
assumptions: Student and teacher names are interpretive aliases for existing actors; all six agents remain
Giving speaking space is an interpretation of the modeled encounter, not a measured variable
The response increment and empty-code state are local diagnostic inputs, not learned or observed changes
The fresh numerical run is not a proof of exact continuous-time existence, uniqueness, or demographic behavior
